article.title: LitPivot: Developing research ideas through dynamic contextualization within the literature landscape

harvestedTerms.summary: LitPivot is a research tool from Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) that helps researchers navigate literature-initiated pivots — changes in research direction prompted by reading prior work. The system segments research proposals into facets (problem, contribution, evaluation), retrieves and groups relevant papers per facet, offers critique supported by excerpts, and suggests targeted revisions. A study with 17 researchers showed proposals developed with LitPivot were rated better grounded in literature than those developed with standard AI chat tools.

article.title: Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads

harvestedTerms.summary: Pennsylvania's Governor signed the AI Deceptive Advertising Act, requiring labels on AI-generated or significantly modified advertising content across all formats. The law has notable loopholes around what constitutes 'significant modification' and 'false consumer perception,' and includes carve-outs for parody and evidently fictional content.
